case: EP-3 crisis, 2001: limited agreement and reserved disputes
classification_policy: Mixed record ledger: public demands, diplomatic instrument, acceptance, internal preparation, implementation and retrospective claims are explicitly distinguished. Internal guidance is not a bilateral offer; retrospective accounts are not independently observed moves.
date_policy: Publication, recollection and intended action dates are separate. Exact date remains unknown where unestablished. Sun’s published timestamp does not establish the time of the oral briefing. April 11 authorization is not physical crew departure.
commitment_policy: Responsibility, reconnaissance, crew departure, aircraft inspection, disposition, technical execution and payment are separate objects. April 29 inspection is not aircraft return; acknowledging an agenda item is not accepting a substantive concession.

moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Public statement directed to United States and domestic/international audiences
moves.issue_and_baseline: Collision responsibility, apology, reconnaissance, entry and immunity
moves.package_and_version: April 3 statement with five numbered positions; not bilateral agreed facts
moves.observed_move_or_state: Demands US responsibility, explanation, apology and prevention; advances factual and legal allegations.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Public MFA position established; original leadership instructions and fact-finding record absent.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: US public demand retains crew-plus-aircraft return; China later accepts narrower crew arrangement without relinquishing responsibility claims.

source_references.locator: Entire body, collision account and numbered positions 1–5

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Link responsibility and relationship repair to crisis demands.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Sincere but inaccurate initial assessment or domestic public justification rather than calculated maximalist tactic.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Dated instructions, initial reports and evidence of beliefs before public demands.

moves.confidence: high for statement, unresolved for beliefs and tactic

moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Rose Garden, Washington; US and Chinese public audiences
moves.issue_and_baseline: Return of 24 crew and damaged aircraft
moves.observed_move_or_state: Calls for both crew and aircraft to return and warns of harm to bilateral relationship.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: President speaks publicly; actual mandate and conditional fallback options not acquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: April 11 letter stages immediate crew departure separately from future aircraft-return planning.

source_references.locator: Printed p.364, target remarks and editorial note

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Public urgency plus relationship costs; initial objects later follow different schedules.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Public bargaining position may differ from fallback instructions already available to US delegation.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Decision memoranda and proposals showing when separation became acceptable.

moves.confidence: high for public demand; unknown initial private fallback

moves.record_type: internal legal preparation, not a bilateral offer
moves.actor: Daniel J. Dell’Orto; DoD/Chairman’s legal offices with State Legal Adviser consultation
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Memo to defense secretary and deputy secretary; internal audience
moves.issue_and_baseline: Regret, factual uncertainty, emergency landing, aircraft and crew status
moves.package_and_version: Signed cover and four enclosure groups, 21 physical pages; not Prueher-letter drafts
moves.observed_move_or_state: Transmits legal papers combining sympathy for Chinese loss with preserved US legal positions; distinguishes crew/aircraft legal status while demanding aircraft release immediately.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Cover records consultation; informational memorandum, not presidential authorization or Chinese acceptance.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Released April 11 letter combines sympathetic language with emergency context, but textual transmission from this packet is unproved.

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Institutional preparation permits sympathetic expression without conceded responsibility.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Routine legal defense with no material effect on negotiation language.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Draft circulation and decision records linking packet to actual proposed/accepted text.

moves.confidence: high for internal positions and consultation; causal role unresolved

moves.record_type: internal communications clearance, not observed public delivery
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: State legal press guidance; oral/off-camera response if pressed
moves.issue_and_baseline: Aircraft immunity and level of public legal explanation
moves.package_and_version: Tab C guidance and its clearance sheet
moves.observed_move_or_state: Clears specific guidance and restricts its intended presentation; multiple office entries marked OK.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Clearance applies to this guidance, not all policy or final Prueher letter. Whether wording was used in actual press encounter unknown.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: April 11 public letter contains limited operational wording rather than the whole legal argument.

source_references.locator: Physical p.9 / OSD1817 and p.14 / OSD1822

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Audience-specific presentation can coexist with retained internal legal claims.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Routine press management unrelated to bargaining flexibility.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Use logs, actual public statements and proposed letter versions.

moves.confidence: high for designated use/clearances; no inference of actual delivery

moves.actor: Joseph Prueher, Kenneth Lieberthal and Colin Powell as recalled by Prueher
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Private advice, US approval and Beijing negotiation, recollected in 2019
moves.issue_and_baseline: Stalemate over physical fault versus a negotiable path to crew return
moves.observed_move_or_state: Prueher recalls advice and approval to move past fault arguments.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: First-person account of US approval; no original instruction or Chinese response record acquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Final public letter reserves causes for later discussion, consistent with but not proof of recalled causal sequence.

source_references.locator: EP-3 discussion around local text lines 504–534

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Reframe immediate objective while leaving attribution unresolved.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Later participant reconstructs successful outcome as effect of chosen approach.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Contemporaneous dated advice/instructions and draft changes before/after.

moves.record_type: released diplomatic letter and publicly reported delivery
moves.actor: Joseph W. Prueher on behalf of US Government; addressed to Tang Jiaxuan
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Beijing MFA; formal diplomatic channel with public release
moves.issue_and_baseline: Crew departure, collision causes, aircraft return, reconnaissance and prevention
moves.package_and_version: Official released English letter; typed name, not inspected original signature
moves.observed_move_or_state: Expresses sorrow, retains emergency-account context, records meeting agreement and US expectation of prompt crew departure; schedules April 18 talks including an aircraft-return plan and acknowledges China’s intended reconnaissance topic.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Fleischer says Bush approved whole letter and signed-copy delivery; clearance record and drafts not acquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Tang announces permission for crew departure after formalities; cause and aircraft questions continue.

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Limited instrument separates immediate action from disputed attribution/policy.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Agreement chiefly driven by wider relationship costs, with language implementing an already authorized decision.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Successive drafts and authorization timestamps for both sides.

moves.confidence: high for published terms and paired delivery reports

moves.setting_channel_and_audience: MFA public account of formal acceptance
moves.issue_and_baseline: Crew departure after receipt of letter; Chinese responsibility position retained
moves.observed_move_or_state: Accepts letter as 致歉信 and announces that 24 crew members may depart after necessary formalities on stated humanitarian grounds; declares the incident unfinished.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Government decision announced by foreign minister; internal release-order timing and deliberation not acquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Further talks publicly announced April 18; aircraft disposition remains unresolved.

source_references.locator: Complete body, crew clause and unfinished-incident passage

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Public justification accommodates immediate action without abandoning all claims.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Humanitarian/relationship decision would have occurred with other tolerable wording.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Chinese decision and proposed alternatives with approval timing.

moves.confidence: high for announced authorization; motivation unproved

moves.record_type: official public interpretation of diplomatic instrument
moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Domestic/international public account; selected Chinese letter excerpts
moves.issue_and_baseline: Public meaning of US expressions and remaining Chinese demands
moves.package_and_version: Delivery report, not a complete Chinese parallel translation
moves.observed_move_or_state: Labels letter 致歉信 and renders selected expressions 深表歉意; item does not reproduce the complete English letter.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Official publication demonstrates authorized public framing; jointly authenticated bilingual text not obtained.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Sun Q&A explicitly addresses the distinction between 道歉 and 深表歉意; substantive disputes remain.

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Maintain a publicly acceptable account alongside limited negotiated action.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Ordinary selective news reporting; no deliberate deception or linguistic misunderstanding demonstrated.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Publication instructions and complete authenticated Chinese version, if one existed.

moves.confidence: High for text; interpretation intent unresolved

moves.setting_channel_and_audience: MFA press Q&A; domestic and international audiences
moves.issue_and_baseline: Question contrasts 道歉 with 深表歉意 and asks about compromise
moves.package_and_version: Eight exchanges; publication time does not prove the briefing preceded delivery
moves.observed_move_or_state: Affirms official letter and humanitarian departure, reserves investigation and aircraft disposition, and repeats the reconnaissance demand.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Spokesman’s public position; investigative findings and private instructions absent.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: April 18 talks continue on unresolved issues.

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Clarify immediate action while protecting unresolved positions.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Public justification could conceal a greater private concession or internal disagreement.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Instructions and actual bilateral record of reserved commitments.

moves.confidence: High for published answers; exact time of speaking unestablished

moves.record_type: Contemporary public chronology of earlier authorizations
moves.issue_and_baseline: Final delivery and US approval behind the letter
moves.package_and_version: Spokesperson chronology, not actual clearance cable
moves.observed_move_or_state: Reports signed-copy delivery around 05:00–06:00 and verbal release assurances; says President approved the entire letter.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Direct public attribution of presidential approval; underlying approval record unacquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Publicly announced arrangement proceeds; ambassador’s signature alone cannot establish lack of presidential authorization.

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Formal agency and top-level authorization can be split across different actors without lessening commitment.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Public spokesperson compresses a more complex or contested clearance process.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Presidential/NSC clearances, embassy report and signed original.

moves.confidence: High for public statement; clearance process not reconstructed

moves.actor: Lu Shumin-led PRC delegation; US delegation not named in item
moves.issue_and_baseline: Collision causes, reconnaissance, prevention and later aircraft arrangements
moves.observed_move_or_state: Repeats Chinese full-responsibility and reconnaissance-cessation demands; announces continuation April 19.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Delegation head identified; text of US response and instructions missing.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: April 29 statement separately records inspection permission and continuing disposition talks.

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Reserved disputes continue after limited agreement.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Public line could overstate private intransigence or conceal incremental progress.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Meeting minutes, April 18 State cable and Chinese record.

moves.confidence: High for public position; private exchanges unknown

moves.record_type: Official inspection authorization and progress report
moves.issue_and_baseline: Aircraft evidence collection, inspection, payments and final disposition
moves.observed_move_or_state: Announces inspection permission after evidence collection; reports discussion of payment and MMCA; final disposition remains under negotiation.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Inspection authorization public; technical access conditions and payment proposal texts not acquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: May 29 agreement in principle on commercial transport of the disassembled aircraft.

interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Inspection agreement, technical reports and financial terms.

moves.confidence: High for announced stage; unpublished package unknown

moves.actor: Zhu Bangzao / PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs
moves.package_and_version: 原则同意 commercial An-124 transport of disassembled aircraft; technical details open

moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: MFA announces government position; original signed technical arrangement not acquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: June 7 US briefing describes runway assessment and disassembly planning.

moves.setting_channel_and_audience: Pentagon public briefing; State Washington File reproduction on historical mirror
moves.issue_and_baseline: Aircraft disassembly, runway limits, transport and communications
moves.observed_move_or_state: Explains dependence on load assessment and remaining logistics; estimates weeks before component departure and reports no communications hindrance under the team’s arrangements.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Public technical account; commercial contracts and work instructions not acquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: July 3 China reports completed disassembly and return; payments remain open.

interpretation.proposed_mechanism: Material implementation constraints create elapsed time independently of deliberate delay.
interpretation.strongest_rival: Some constraints or access conditions may have been politically imposed; briefing cannot exclude leverage.
interpretation.discriminating_evidence_needed: Work logs, Chinese access conditions, contractor records and critical-path assessment.

moves.confidence: High for published explanation; underlying measurements not verified

moves.observed_move_or_state: Reports completed disassembly and US-chartered An-124 return while payments remain under negotiation.
moves.authority_evidence_and_unknowns: Official account; exact component-flight and US arrival records not acquired.
moves.next_observable_response_or_state: Payment resolution not examined beyond this cutoff.

new_propositions.claim: Separating immediate humanitarian action from attribution and policy questions may have made an otherwise unacceptable package feasible in this episode.
new_propositions.status: Mechanism hypothesis: structure observed, causation unproved.
new_propositions.supporting_test: A dated draft or instruction links the change in scope to acceptance.
new_propositions.disconfirming_or_weakening_test: Release was already authorized independently, or acceptance depended on a different concession.

new_propositions.claim: A channel’s informational value for resolution depends on whether reporting reaches and can be evaluated by the officials who authorize change.
